nodes.description: Oracle.token0: address of token0 of the Uniswap pair
Oracle.token1: address of token1 of the Uniswap pair
Oracle.pair: IUniswapV2Pair instance used as price source
Oracle.blockTimestampLast: last observed pair timestamp (uint32)
Oracle.price0CumulativeLast: last stored cumulative price of token0
Oracle.price1CumulativeLast: last stored cumulative price of token1
Oracle.price0Average: fixed point average price of token0
Oracle.price1Average: fixed point average price of token1
Epoch.period: epoch length in seconds, governable
Epoch.startTime: epoch schedule start timestamp
Epoch.epoch: current epoch counter
Oracle constructor: resolves pair via UniswapV2Library.pairFor and records reserves and cumulative prices
Oracle.update: recomputes average prices over the elapsed period, guarded by checkEpoch
Oracle.consult: returns the amountOut using the stored average price
Oracle.pairFor: pure wrapper over library address computation
Epoch.setPeriod: operator-only governance setter for period
Epoch.nextEpochPoint: startTime + epoch*period
Epoch.getCurrentEpoch: returns current epoch counter
msg.sender: caller identity used by onlyOwner/onlyOperator checks
block.timestamp (now): block time driving epoch transitions
Division of cumulative price delta by timeElapsed in update, guarded only by an early return
External call to pair.getReserves()/price cumulative getters trusting pair return values
Explicit truncating cast to uint224 of the average price in update
Owner/operator authorization check gating privileged state changes
Constructor parameter _factory (Uniswap factory address)
consult parameter token: token whose average price is queried
consult parameter amountIn: input amount to convert
update local timeElapsed: blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast (wrapping subtraction)
update local price0Cumulative returned by UniswapV2OracleLibrary
setPeriod parameter _period: new epoch length

edges.reason: Oracle constructor stores the resolved pair into state variable pair
constructor reads pair.token0() and writes state token0
constructor reads pair.token1() and writes state token1
blockTimestampLast is initialized from trust-external pair.getReserves() return value
checkEpoch modifier compares now (block.timestamp) against nextEpochPoint to allow update execution
timeElapsed is derived from blockTimestamp which derives from block.timestamp
update computes local timeElapsed inside the function body
timeElapsed is the divisor of the average price computation; zero value is only guarded by an early return
update assigns the cumulative price returned by the oracle library to a local variable
the cumulative price difference is cast down to uint224, truncating high bits
the uint224 cast result is written into price0Average
update refreshes price0CumulativeLast from the observed cumulative price
update refreshes price1CumulativeLast from the observed cumulative price
update overwrites blockTimestampLast with the freshly observed blockTimestamp
consult reads price0Average when token equals token0
consult reads price1Average when token equals token1
the token parameter selects which average price branch consult executes
amountIn parameter is multiplied by the stored average price in consult
setPeriod writes the new _period value into the period state variable
the _period parameter is the value assigned to state period inside setPeriod
msg.sender is compared against _owner/_operator inside the authorization modifiers
the onlyOperator check gates execution of setPeriod
setPeriod can only be reached by an address equal to _operator derived from msg.sender
nextEpochPoint adds startTime into the returned epoch boundary
nextEpochPoint multiplies period by the epoch counter
nextEpochPoint multiplies the current epoch value by period
nextEpochPoint result is compared against block.timestamp in the checkEpoch modifier
getCurrentEpoch returns the epoch state variable
the _factory constructor parameter is passed to UniswapV2Library.pairFor to derive the pair
pairFor performs the same CREATE2 address derivation used to populate the pair state variable

normalization_plan.reason: _factory is only used inside the Oracle constructor to resolve the pair address and has no standalone semantics
token is a call argument consumed only by consult's branch selection
amountIn is a transient input multiplied by the stored average in consult
timeElapsed exists solely to be the divisor of the average price computation and its zero-guard is embodied by that unsafe operation
price0Cumulative is a temporary holding the oracle library result before being cast and stored by update
_period is just the value written into the period state variable by the operator-only setter
